en: Illustrated view of the Potala Palace on a hill above the city of Lhasa, surrounded by mountains and scattered buildings below. The image is framed like a collectible trade card or postcard with Dutch text describing Lhasa as the holy city of Lamaism and mentioning the Potala, the 'besielde berg' (ensouled or sacred mountain). At the bottom is an advertisement line for Liebig products, and on the right a facsimile signature 'J. Liebig'.
